name: takeout-pull
description: Stop a Google Takeout export from expiring undownloaded: detect the ready-to-download mails with a deterministic zero-token scan, report the live links with days remaining, then drive the download and vault import. Triggers: "/takeout-pull", "is my takeout ready", "pull my takeout".
